text.en:
The sum of forty seven thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be spent by the
Director of Lands, with the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce, as follows:
For the repair of the Diezmo Dam, in Santa Rosa, Laguna
For the repair of the Anabu Dam in Imus, Cavite
10,000.00
For the construction of a dam, to be known as the Katipunan Dam in the barrio of Palangue, Naic, Cavite
10,000.00
For the repair of the Tubigan Dam in Binan, Laguna
20,000.00
-------------

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 8, 1936, except the last two items.
